source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of the extraction of Group 2 elements (PDF 12).

blocks.text: Group 2 anasir aur un ke compounds wafir qudrati zaraye se hasil hote hain. Do ahem amal samandari paani se magnesium nikalna (Dow process) aur choone ke pathar se quicklime banana hain.

blocks.prompt: Dow process mein kaun sa zariya use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Samandari paani, jis mein kam miqdar mein Mg2+ ions hote hain.

items: Samandari paani se Mg (Dow process); choone ke pathar se CaO (lime kiln).
